support_claim: MSA-OAK-2018 names Oakfield Logistics GmbH as counterparty and billing uses Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and the unchanged Handelsregister number HRB 88421 across the 2023 rebranding establishes they are the same legal entity.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: The contract counterparty is named Oakfield Logistics GmbH while the billing referent is Oakfield Logistik GmbH; the unchanged registration number links the former and current legal names as the same entity.

propositions.proposition: Handelsregister entry HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH as an active company in Germany.
propositions.relevance: Confirms the billing-side name Oakfield Logistik GmbH corresponds to a registered legal entity; paired with the unchanged HRB 88421 noted at rebrand, it supports continuity with the contract counterparty name.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use billed_name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH to the legal name appearing on invoices.

propositions.proposition: Contract MSA-OAK-2018 lists Counterparty: Oakfield Logistics GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the counterparty named in the right referent contract:MSA-OAK-2018.
